facts.text: SLCPs cause up to 45% of present warming; IPCC — rapid cuts can avoid up to 0.6°C by 2050
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Also called: super pollutants, Short-Lived Climate Forcers
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Major warming SLCPs: black carbon, methane, tropospheric ozone, HFCs
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: ⚠ Black carbon is not a greenhouse gas — a particle that absorbs radiation; sulphate aerosols cool
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: ⚠ Tropospheric ozone is not directly emitted — formed from methane, NOx, VOCs in sunlight
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Methane: ~80 times CO2 warming over 20 years; second-largest contributor after CO2
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Stratospheric ozone ~10–50 km; tropospheric surface–10 km
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Ozone causes loss of ~110 million tonnes staple crops/year; air pollution ~7 million premature deaths/year globally
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Air pollution: 1.67 million deaths in 2019 (17.8%), loss US$36.8 billion (1.36% of GDP)
facts.head: India

facts.text: Residential fuels = ~60% of South Asia's black carbon; Indo-Gangetic Plain hotspot
facts.head: India

facts.text: Methane (2016, Third BUR): Agriculture 73.96%, Waste 14.46%, Energy 10.62%, Industry 0.96%
facts.head: India

facts.text: ⚠ India has not joined the Global Methane Pledge — calls farm methane "survival emissions"
facts.head: India

facts.text: Instrument: Montreal Protocol; Fact: 1987 — ozone-depleting substances
facts.head: International framework

facts.text: Instrument: Kigali Amendment; Fact: 2016; India ratified Sept 2021; freeze HFCs by 2028, cut 85% by 2047; can avoid 0.5°C by 2100
facts.head: International framework

facts.text: Instrument: Global Methane Pledge; Fact: COP26 Glasgow 2021; cut 30% from 2020 levels by 2030; 159 countries + EC
facts.head: International framework

facts.text: Instrument: Climate and Clean Air Coalition; Fact: UNEP-led; India joined 2019
facts.head: International framework

facts.text: Air Act 1981; NAAQS 2009 (12 pollutants); National AQI 2015; GRAP 2017 (Delhi-NCR)
facts.head: India's measures

facts.text: NCAP: 130 cities, 24 States/UTs; 2025–26: 65 cities within PM2.5 limit 40 µg/m³; Delhi 102 µg/m³; only 14 met PM10 (60 µg/m³)
facts.head: India's measures

facts.text: PMUY: >10.5 crore LPG connections; GOBARdhan; SRI, DSR, alternate wetting & drying
facts.head: India's measures

facts.text: Released by: Union MoEFCC Minister, New Delhi
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Period: 2025–26 to 2030–31; ₹767 crore; Central Sector Scheme
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Coverage: 9 coastal States + 4 UTs; directly administered by MoEFCC
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Integrates NCM 1.0 (2021–22 to 2025–26); framework for Marine Spatial Planning (MSP), climate resilience, marine pollution, Blue Economy
facts.head: Key facts

pages.title: India's first high-altitude Snow Leopard Safari — Leh

facts.text: Launched 7 October 2026, Leh, Ladakh (Wildlife Week); LG Vinai Kumar Saxena flagged off 6 open-back vehicles
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Implemented by: SHAN Society (Snow Leopard and High-Altitude Nature Conservation) + Ladakh Forest Dept
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: SPAI 2024: India 718 snow leopards — Ladakh 477 (highest)
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: *Panthera uncia*; IUCN Vulnerable; WPA Schedule I; CITES Appendix I
facts.head: Background

facts.text: State animal of Himachal Pradesh; UT animal of Ladakh; International Snow Leopard Day 23 October; Project Snow Leopard 2009
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Ladakh UT since 31 October 2019
facts.head: Background

pages.title: Two Great Indian Bustards released in Desert National Park

facts.text: Union Environment Minister released two captive-bred male GIBs at Sam, Desert National Park, near Jaisalmer
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: DNP: Thar Desert, >3,160 sq km; rainfall <100 mm; Jurassic fossils; extinct salt-lake beds
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: GIB: *Ardeotis nigriceps*; IUCN Critically Endangered; Rajasthan State Bird; threat — power lines
facts.head: Key facts

pages.title: New plant species Didymocarpus nautiyalii — Arunachal Pradesh

facts.text: Found in: Shi-Yomi district, Arunachal Pradesh
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Family: Gesneriaceae; herb ~8 cm; leathery leaves, blue-violet flowers; moist rocks above 1,000 m
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Named after: Prof. Sunil Nautiyal, former Director, G.B. Pant National Institute of Himalayan Environment (Almora, Uttarakhand; under MoEFCC)
facts.head: Key facts

pages.title: Uttarakhand's first real-time glacial lake early warning system — Vasundhara Lake

facts.text: Where: Vasundhara Lake, Chamoli district, Uttarakhand — first real-time GLOF early warning system in the State
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Monitors water level, weather, snow depth, flow, seismic activity; satellite communication (no mobile network); solar-powered
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: GLOF: sudden release from glacial lake — moraine/ice dam failure, avalanches, landslides
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Uttarakhand: capital Dehradun, summer capital Gairsain
facts.head: Background

pages.title: India's first port-based e-methanol plant — Deendayal Port, Kandla

facts.text: Where: Deendayal Port Authority, Gandhidham–Kandla, Gujarat (Gulf of Kutch; formerly Kandla Port)
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Partners: DPA + Assam Petro-Chemicals Ltd (APCL), Namrup, Assam
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Capacity: 150 tonnes/day; green marine fuel
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: E-methanol: renewable electricity + water + biogenic CO2
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Aletsch (Switzerland) — largest and longest glacier in the Alps; part of Swiss Alps Jungfrau–Aletsch UNESCO site; valley glacier
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Swiss glaciers lost 5.5% of remaining ice in 2026 — second-highest after 2022 (per GLAMOS and SCNAT)
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Causes: low winter snowfall + record summer heatwaves
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Ash up to 6 km; Kanlaon — active stratovolcano on Negros Island, Visayas; Pacific Ring of Fire

facts.text: Other volcanoes: Mayon, Taal, Pinatubo; capital Manila, Peso
